# Drone News 48h Brief — September 29, 2026

_Window: last 48 hours; 67 incidents._

## Summary
In the past 48 hours, a significant number of drone incidents were reported, primarily focused on security and smuggling. Notably, over 30 unauthorized drones were observed at a Seahawks parade, raising security concerns. In Ukraine, Russian drone attacks caused widespread fear, killing five individuals across the country, including in locations like Kyiv. Meanwhile, multiple reports highlighted the ongoing challenge of drones used for prison-related smuggling, prompting calls for stricter measures, especially in regions like Georgia. Concurrently, counter-drone drills were held in Taiwan to prepare for potential threats. These incidents reflect a disturbing trend of drone misuse in both civilian and high-stakes scenarios, necessitating urgent policy discussions and protective measures.
